title: Pause the Game
can_do: 需要上厕所或休息时，让对方知道活动必须暂停。

conversation_move.label: request a pause for a body need

trigger: Dad proposes another round, but the child needs the bathroom before play can continue.
core_response: I need to use the bathroom.
stretch_response: I need to use the bathroom. Please pause the game.
repair_response: Wait, I need to go now.
setting: Playing a simple card game at home.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Let us start another round of the animal game.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Wait. I need to use the bathroom.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Okay. Shall I pause the game here?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes, please. Keep my card right there.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: The game is paused. Come back when you are ready.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I am back now. We can keep playing.

replay_cards.title: Rest during dancing
replay_cards.challenge: Ask to stop the music, rest, then say whether to restart or finish

replay_cards.title: Bathroom before leaving
replay_cards.change: The child needs the bathroom after shoes are on
replay_cards.challenge: Tell Dad now, leave the shoes by the door, return, and continue leaving

parent_support: Pause promptly for a bathroom need; language practice must never delay it.
Show what will stay in place so the child knows the activity can resume.
